description: The PR panel exposed Create Pull Request and Create Draft PR while the compact form had no visible copy explaining that the action would generate PR details and create a real GitHub pull request from the current branch.
expected: Before an external GitHub write, the panel should name the source branch, base branch, and whether details will be generated automatically.
actual: The compact PR form only showed Create Pull Request, PR options, and Edit title & description. The action was available with blank title/body and no visible consequence copy.
suggested_fix: Add compact consequence copy to the PR form and explicit labels for the generate-message/details icon buttons.
